state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress: `--check syntax` exists, and "Start here" and the four Basics pages are written.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` heading with a `- ` list under it. Every roster feature `isSyntaxFeature` names must be covered, and each one that is not covered is listed as `uncovered:`. `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts` tests it.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx` and `syntax/basics/{files-and-statements,comments,variables,constants}.mdx`, their snippets under `website/snippets/syntax/`, the sidebar entries in `website/astro.config.ts`, and their stamps in `website/site.lock.json`. Each page follows goal § Stage 4: the short way first, then "Use this when", then Do and don't.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass, and the site builds. `site syntax` reports 171 uncovered features: 118 `lang:` sections, plus 53 Core types the roster files under `types/` (the `Throwable` tree, `Comparable` and the other Core interfaces, every Core enum). `snippets` and `prose` fail only on the pages stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

items.text: **Values and types**: numbers, strings and interpolation, bool and null, arrays and `array<T>`, nullable `?T`, union types, enums, `as`, `is`. Covers the `lang:types/*` sections and `lang:enums/*`. The Core enums (`Core\Order` and the rest) go in the `covers:` of the enums page. Goal § Stage 4. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/20-types.md:68`, `docs/reference/lang/55-enums.md:1`, `website/astro.config.ts:126`

**Operators and Control flow**: covers `lang:expressions/*` and `lang:statements/*` except try, catch and throw, which go to Errors. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:1`, `docs/reference/lang/40-statements.md:1`

**Errors**: throw and catch, error types, checked returns. Covers `lang:errors/*`, the statements chapter's try, catch and throw sections, and the `Throwable` tree with every Core exception. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/70-errors.md:1`

backlog: Functions, Classes and objects (with the Core interfaces `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses`, `PropertyObserver`, `Iterable`, `Iterator`), Programs and files, Special syntax, and pages for `lang:` chapters the outline misses (concurrency, iteration, testing). Goal § Stage 4.
Stage 5 rewrites `install/hello-world.mdx`, `install/index.mdx` and `sponsoring.mdx`, which fail `snippets` and `prose`. Goal § Stage 5.
